title: Build hybrid FP8/INT8 quant profiles and segmented ranking evaluation harness
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: produce and validate a set of hybrid quantization profiles that mix FP8 for attention / normalization-sensitive subgraphs and INT8 for compute-heavy matmuls in the reranker model. Build an evaluation harness that measures ranking quality (NDCG@1/3/10, MRR) across stratified query slices (short/long context, tail/popular queries, vertical/domain) and emits stable regression signals for CI gating.

Scope:
- Define 4 candidate profiles (float baseline, FP8-primary, INT8-primary, hybrid-attn-fp8).
- Implement calibration pipeline to collect activation histograms and per-channel scales from representative traffic and offline corpora.
- Create quantize-and-eval workflow that runs on CI with deterministic seeding and dataset splits.
- Produce a per-slice difference report relative to float baseline and thresholded pass/fail for rollouts.

Calibration approach:
1) Data selection: sample 250k reranker queries from production logs (obfuscated), plus 25k curated out-of-domain examples to exercise failure modes. Stratify samples by query length and item popularity.
2) Instrumentation: capture activation min/max and 256-bin histograms for target layers during a float pass. Store artifacts in S3 path: s3://redwood-quant/ENG-40621/calib-v1/.
3) Algorithm: run per-channel symmetric INT8 calibration for matmuls, per-tensor asymmetric FP8 for attention and layernorm-sensitive layers. Explore KL-divergence scoring and MSE heuristics to pick clip thresholds.
4) Optional QAT step: for profiles that show >0.75% NDCG drop, run a 3-epoch calibration-aware fine-tune on a held-out 20k set with learning-rate warmup to recover quality.

Evaluation metrics and gating:
- Primary: relative NDCG@3 and MRR changes vs float baseline. Acceptance thresholds: NDCG@3 drop <= 0.5% (relative) and MRR drop <= 1.0% (relative) across overall sample.
- Secondary: per-slice delta thresholds: no slice should see NDCG@3 drop > 1.5% or MRR drop > 2.5%.
- Latency/cost: report p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec improvement and per-token GPU cost estimate.
- Stability: run 5 random seeds for the quantize step; report mean and std.

Rollout strategy: canary 5% traffic to hybrid profile with realtime monitoring on the reranker console dashboard. Auto-rollback if overall NDCG@3 degradation > 0.7% for 30m or any slice breach as above.

Acceptance criteria and deliverables are enumerated below.
acceptance_criteria: Four quant profiles implemented and stored under profiles/ENG-40621/ with versioned metadata
Calibration artifacts (histograms, min/max) uploaded to s3://redwood-quant/ENG-40621/calib-v1/
Evaluation harness that computes NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR per-slice and emits JSON report in results/ with deterministic seeding
Automated CI job that gates PRs by running quantize+eval on a 10k sample (fast smoke) and a nightly 250k full run
Comparison dashboard with latency/cost tradeoffs and canary auto-rollback rules configured
Documentation (Confluence) with runbook for calibration, QAT fallback, and manual investigation checklist
